newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Westinghouse Electric begun.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Westinghouse Electric begun.

text.p: UBS Securities said on Friday it began coverage of Westinghouse Electric Corp with a strong buy rating and a 12- to 18-month target of $31 per share.
-- Analyst Edward Hatch said Westinghouse's CBS unit was forecast to be the fastest growing television broadcaster, with 23 percent annual cash flow growth.

-- "We believe that the shares will have unusually strong appeal due to the broadcast pure-play and strong free cash flow characteristics relative to other major media conglomerate company prospects," he said in a research note.
-- Hatch's proforma earnings estimates, for the new CBS after Westinghouse's restructuring, were a loss of $0.07 per share in 1997 and a profit of $0.73 per share in 1998.
-- "The pending break-up of Westinghouse into separate media and industrial companies will enable both parts to better leverage their respective strengths," he said.
